title: A simple and fast method for extraction and quantification of cryptophyte phycoerythrin
author: Thoisen, Hansen, et al.

steps.title: Filter cells onto GF/C filter
steps.instruction: Filter the microalgae cells onto a Whatman™ GF/C filter (0.2 µm) using a pressure of approximately 34 kPa.

steps.title: Add solvent and freeze filter
steps.instruction: Fold each filter midway with cells inside, place it in a Pyrex glass vial, add 3 mL of 0.1 M phosphate buffer (pH 6.7, 0.05 M K₂HPO₄, 0.05 M KH₂PO₄), and freeze at –80 °C for 24 h.

substeps.instruction: Transfer folded filter to a Pyrex glass vial.
Add 3 mL extraction solvent (0.1 M phosphate buffer, pH 6.7, 0.05 M K₂HPO₄, 0.05 M KH₂PO₄).

steps.title: Extract at 4 °C
steps.instruction: After freezing, place the vials in a refrigerator at 4 °C and allow extraction to proceed for 24 h.

steps.title: Filter extract into cuvette
steps.instruction: Transfer the extraction solvent with a 150 mm Pasteur glass pipette into a 5 mL syringe fitted with a 0.2 µm cellulose acetate membrane filter (25 mm), then filter the solution into a disposable plastic cuvette (1 cm path length).

substeps.instruction: Use a 150 mm Pasteur pipette to draw the extract.
Dispense into a 5 mL syringe equipped with a 0.2 µm cellulose acetate filter (25 mm).
Filter the extract directly into a disposable plastic cuvette (1 cm path).

steps.title: Measure absorbance and correct scatter
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance of the sample at 455, 564, 592 and 750 nm on a spectrophotometer using phosphate buffer as blank; subtract the 750 nm value from the other readings to correct for scatter, and keep samples protected from light (e.g., wrap in foil) throughout.

substeps.instruction: Set spectrophotometer blank with phosphate buffer.
Record absorbance at 455 nm, 564 nm, 592 nm, and 750 nm.
Subtract the 750 nm absorbance from the other three values to obtain scatter‑corrected values.
Avoid excess light exposure by wrapping cuvettes in foil during the whole process.

steps.title: Calculate phycoerythrin concentration
steps.instruction: Compute phycoerythrin (PE) concentration using the formula: PE (mg · mL⁻¹) = [(A564 − A592) − (A455 − A592) × 0.2] × 0.12, where A denotes the scatter‑corrected absorbance at each wavelength.
